Subject: Your land dispute matter - O.S. No. 2855/2023

Dear Ms. Menon,

Thank you for meeting us on 8 October 2023 about your dispute with Naveen Kulkarni. As we understand it, the neighbour has encroached on the boundary of the plot.

Our advice is to apply for a court commissioner to measure the boundary. Please collect the sale deed, the survey map and the land records and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Zubin Contractor
